newsitem.title: USA: Tests confirm that Clinton cyst benign.
newsitem.headline: Tests confirm that Clinton cyst benign.

text.p: Pathology reports on the cyst that was removed from President Bill Clinton's neck confirmed preliminary assessments that it was benign, the White House said on Friday.
"It feels fine," Clinton told reporters on Air Force One when asked about the minor surgery performed on Wednesday at the White House.
White Press Secretary Mike McCurry said Clinton was notified earlier on Friday "that it was a benign epidermal cyst ... the pathology report came back negative."
